description: This file contains utility functions and a main exported function 'answerFromDashboard' that processes user questions about financial dashboard data, returning answers based on snapshot data. It also includes a helper function 'getDashboardClarification' for user query clarification.

methods.name: answerFromDashboard
methods.description: Answers user questions about dashboard metrics using snapshot data, employing heuristics to identify the requested metric and generate a response.

methods.name: getDashboardClarification
methods.description: Determines if a user query is unclear and provides prompts and suggestions for clarification.
